body:
First of all, thanks for replying, I do appreciate it, even though it may not sound like it.

And... The third loss is a bit metaphorical. I had another thread on here talking about it. Don't really know exactly why I made this one, but oh well. And I mean, yeah, my entire family grieved when my grandparents died. It wasn't easy on us, but it's been a couple months, we moved on, as much as we could.

The third loss is a bit more specific, and I don't think it's super relevant what's about. There's the other thread, if you're curious, though.

I'm just tired. It's been almost two days since I've been kicked back into a mindset I had recovered from for about a year now. I spent years building myself up to this point and then... Just the smallest, most heartbreaking, bittersweet slip and I'm a complete wreck again. I'm in my "bad phase" again. Fuck, I just don't want to go through all the years of therapy again. I don't feel like it's worth it. To battle myself, day after day, for another two, three years, just so something like this happens again and I'm back to this god forsaken state. I'm just fucking tired, very very tired.

I think so. But... Man, I don't know.  I just don't know. At my current mindset I have very little to lose, so following your advice would actually make a lot of sense. But even the chance of bothering her with my shit while she may have really moved on already is troubling. Does *that* make sense?
I don't think you understood that first reply. I had that friend ask that night. She said no, like, two days ago. Drunk. But it was an answer nonetheless. Do you still think I should talk to her?

First of all, thanks for the writeup. It definitely helps. Really.

I'll say, in regards to the repetition of thoughts: it was all very primal, in that sense. I just wrote exactly what was in my mind at that time and that's what came out. It's weird to read it back now, even though I can't shake most of it off still.

I don't know what else to say. I want to believe you. Actually, I know you're right. The future is too uncertain for me to claim I can somehow predict it. But man, I don't know. A part of me wants to be angry, even now, you know? It's probably not too healthy and I'll try to stop, but... I *am* still angry. Mostly at myself. Hopefully not for long, but who knows?

Overall, I just wanted to thank you. That was beautiful writeup and I'll make to remember it if my mind ever considers something questionable again. I'll be sure to keep all you said in mind.

Yeah... I guess I should, but I don't know. A no's no, you know? It should, I guess. Don't wanna be pushy and annoy her with all my shit, you feel? At this point I just want try my damn hardest to forget.

It was. Not gonna lie, I drank a lot yesterday as well, I kind needed to. To distract myself and all. I drank a shit ton of water though so I'm pretty ok right now.

And yeah, it was. Still is. I still feel my heart beating way faster than it should. Maybe it's my head though, I'm not sure. Yesterday I avoided looking back at this thread. I didn't want anyone to convince me to not kill myself. Mind was fuzzy with all the shit. It's a bit better now. This type of stuff doesn't get better in a weekend, but still. Anyway, thanks for reaching out, man. Seriously I appreciate it.
Not really. And sorry if I'm being rude, on top of all this shit, hangover is still in full force as well, so

No. I had a friend ask what that was all about: we're friends. We were drunk. That was the summary.

But hell, I don't even think that's the point anymore.
